No class-diagram skill was available, so I built this from the production sources by hand. I read `NodeInternals.java` and grepped every non-test file under `src/main/java` that refers to it.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class NodeInternals {
        <<final>>
        -NodeInternals()
        +sourceRange(Node node, LineMap lineMap, int startPos, int endPos)$ void
        +endSourceRange(Element element, LineMap lineMap, int startPos, int endPos)$ void
        +clearEndSourceRange(Element element)$ void
        +sourceDataStart(ProcessingInstruction pi, int pos)$ void
        +attributeRange(Attributes attributes, String key, LineMap lineMap, int nameStart, int nameEnd, int valueStart, int valueEnd)$ void
        +attributeRange(Attributes attributes, String key, Range.AttributeRange range)$ void
    }

    %% ---- Types used by NodeInternals ----
    class Node {
        <<abstract>>
        ~ensureSpans() Range.Spans
        ~spans() Range.Spans
    }
    class LeafNode {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class Element {
        ~ensureSpans() Range.Spans
        ~spans() Range.Spans
    }
    class ProcessingInstruction {
        ~sourceDataStart(int pos) void
    }
    class Attributes {
        +NotFound$ int
        ~visibleIndexOfKey(String key) int
        ~ensureSpans() Range.Spans
    }
    class Range
    class Range_Spans["Range.Spans"] {
        <<final>>
        ~sourceRange(LineMap, int, int) void
        ~endSourceRange(LineMap, int, int) void
        ~clearEndSourceRange() void
        ~attributeRange(int, LineMap, int, int, int, int) void
        ~attributeRange(int, Range.AttributeRange) void
    }
    class Range_AttributeRange["Range.AttributeRange"] {
        +isTracked() boolean
    }
    class LineMap {
        <<final>>
    }
    class Validate {
        <<final>>
        +notNull(Object obj)$ void
    }

    %% ---- Types that use NodeInternals ----
    class TreeBuilder {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class HtmlTreeBuilder
    class XmlTreeBuilder
    class HtmlTreeBuilderState {
        <<enumeration>>
    }
    class Token {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class Cleaner

    %% inheritance / nesting context
    LeafNode --|> Node
    ProcessingInstruction --|> LeafNode
    Element --|> Node
    HtmlTreeBuilder --|> TreeBuilder
    XmlTreeBuilder --|> TreeBuilder
    Range +-- Range_Spans
    Range +-- Range_AttributeRange

    %% NodeInternals -> dependencies
    NodeInternals ..> Node : sourceRange()
    NodeInternals ..> Element : endSourceRange() / clearEndSourceRange()
    NodeInternals ..> ProcessingInstruction : sourceDataStart()
    NodeInternals ..> Attributes : attributeRange()
    NodeInternals ..> LineMap : passes through
    NodeInternals ..> Range_Spans : sets ranges via
    NodeInternals ..> Range_AttributeRange : copies
    NodeInternals ..> Validate : notNull()

    %% clients -> NodeInternals
    TreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals : sourceRange() / endSourceRange()
    HtmlTreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals : sourceDataStart() / clearEndSourceRange()
    XmlTreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals : sourceDataStart()
    HtmlTreeBuilderState ..> NodeInternals : attributeRange()
    Token ..> NodeInternals : attributeRange()
    Cleaner ..> NodeInternals : attributeRange()
```

`LeafNode` and `Range` are the only classes in the diagram that `NodeInternals` doesn't use directly. `LeafNode` is shown because `ProcessingInstruction` inherits from `Node` through it, and `Range` because it holds the nested `Spans` and `AttributeRange` classes.
